finance.monthlyPayment: This is your monthly payment amount. Use this to budget monthly expenses and confirm the loan fits your budget for the full term.
finance.payment: This is your periodic loan payment. Use it when planning recurring expenses.
finance.totalInterest: Total interest paid over the life of the loan — the cost of borrowing. Reduce it with a larger down payment, shorter term, or extra payments.
finance.totalPayment: Total amount paid over the loan term, including principal and interest. Shows the true cost beyond the monthly payment.

math.result: This is the calculated result. Use it in further work or to verify your solution.
math.answer: This is the calculated result. Use it in further work or to verify your solution.
